subject: Botanical Compounds Engage Interlocking Cellular Networks to Shield Aging Neurons
script: From Agewell Brief: Botanical Compounds Engage Interlocking Cellular Networks to Shield Aging Neurons. Multi-omics analysis reveals how plant molecules modify key regulatory proteins, maintain mitochondrial power grids, and reshape chromatin to halt systems-level neuronal decay. Neurodegenerative conditions like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's do not spring from a single broken protein gear. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
